lines:
flowchart TD
    List[Task list] --> Filter{State filter}
    Filter --> OpenFinished[Default open plus finished]
    Filter --> AllStates[All states]
    List --> Detail[Task detail editor]
    Detail --> Create[Create task]
    Detail --> Delete[Delete task]
    Detail --> Links[Search add reorder and remove design links]
    Links --> Jump[Jump to clicked design browser scope]
    Detail --> Confirm{Finished task}
    Confirm --> ConfirmOnly[Confirm]
    Confirm --> ConfirmCommit[Optional confirm plus commit later]
    ConfirmOnly --> Confirmed[Confirmed state]
    ConfirmCommit --> Confirmed
    ConfirmCommit --> CommitId[Store commit id when successful]
